title: vision.vendor_event.v1
description: A normalised AI event ingested from a vendor NVR (e.g. the Dahua estate's smart events). This is VENDOR EVENT INGESTION, not first-party perception: provenance is 'vendor_inferred', the vendor's confidence is carried verbatim and never upgraded to a first-party confidence, and no identity/biometric field is ever admitted. See docs/VISION_BUILD_GATE.md §4.5/§8.

vendor_event_id.description: Deterministic platform id — replay/backfill of the same NVR event is idempotent.

camera_id.description: Registered camera id, or a dahua_nvr:<channel> placeholder when unmapped.

channel.description: NVR channel the event came from.

vendor_type.description: The vendor's raw event code, e.g. CrossLineDetection.

vendor_confidence.description: The vendor's own confidence — carried, never upgraded to first-party.

clip_ref.description: Reference to a clip retained on the edge/NVR — never inline video.

provenance.description: A vendor NVR inference, a distinct provenance class from first-party 'observed'.
